Remote – Philippines |

Full-Time Role | 40 hours per week | 



About the Role:

We’re looking for a highly driven and versatile Executive Assistant to support the CEO of a growing telecom and internet company with a focus on e-commerce operations, digital marketing, and customer engagement. You’ll be the CEO’s “right hand”, working alongside our Operations & Finance Manager to run day-to-day activities, launch digital initiatives, and help scale two brands: 5Star Wireless and Genie ISP.



This role is Full-Time (40 hrs/week)

First 3 months will be probationary period and will be $400/month. If you pass it will be $500/month



 Core Responsibilities:

 E-Commerce & Digital Strategy

BUILD & Manage Shopify product listings and website updates for 5Star Wireless and Genie ISP



Coordinate with the CEO on product launches, pricing updates, and online sales initiatives



Design and improve site conversion, layout, and product display using best Shopify practices



 Social Media Marketing & Content

Design and schedule engaging posts (Instagram,
, TikTok, etc.)



Edit product or promo videos using Canva, CapCut, or similar tools



Collaborate on seasonal campaigns and promotions



Respond to comments/messages in a branded, professional tone



 AI Integration & Automation

Help train and refine internal AI tools (chatbots, automations, support tools)



Use tools like ChatGPT or Sintra to automate business tasks



Assist in creating AI-based customer engagement strategies



 Customer Service, Accounting Support & Admin Tasks

Assist in sending invoices, collecting payments, and tracking subscriptions



Help manage Genie ISP accounts (billing, credits, service questions)



Support accounting-related tasks in QuickBooks (training provided)



Handle light admin work, follow-ups, customer communication, etc.



 Who You’ll Work With

Directly with the CEO for strategy and daily priorities



Alongside our Operations & Finance Manager, for cross-training and process alignment



You’ll be one of two core executive support roles (Operations & Finance Manager = internal systems; You = digital growth)



 Room for Growth

This role is positioned to grow into a Director of E-Commerce or Chief Digital Officer (CDO) in the future



Long-term bonuses and incentives are possible as you help drive measurable results



 Qualifications

1–2 years experience with Shopify (required)



Experience in social media content creation and scheduling



Great written English and communication skills



Familiarity with tools like Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT, Notion, or QuickBooks (or willing to learn)



Reliable internet and able to work EST hours (at least 4–5 hours overlap)



Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions with minimal micromanagement



Bonus if You Have:

Graphic design or video editing experience



Telcom Experience



Experience supporting a CEO or business owner



Prior experience with customer support or e-commerce fulfillment



 Work Hours & Pay

Full-Time: 40 hours/





Pay: Competitive (based on experience) + performance bonuses available



Contract Term: Full- Time



How to Apply

Fill out our google form here 







Once this is completed please send us a message so we can manually review it. Thank you for applying!

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back



How to Apply:

Click the link - 
/o/JB-EG02TR292/landing

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

title: Looking for Freelance 3D Modeler / CAD Designer (Fusion 360 / SolidWorks or Blender) – Paid Test Project
description:
We are looking for a reliable freelance 3D modeler to handle recurring custom 3D printing and product prototyping files (functional parts, enclosures, and custom 3D-printable models).



Requirements:



    Proficiency in Fusion 360 / SolidWorks (for mechanical/parametric parts) OR Blender / ZBrush (for organic sculpting).



    Strong understanding of 3D printing tolerances (manifold/watertight meshes, wall thickness, overhangs, and clean .STL + .STEP exports).



    Reliable 24–48 hour turnaround on small-to-medium models.



To Apply:



    Share a link to 3–5 models you personally designed (screenshots + tell us what software you used).



    List your typical flat-rate range (in PHP) for a simple functional part vs. a detailed custom model.



    Confirm you are open to a quick paid test model (₱500–₱750) this week.



*This position is per project and the salary is only an estimate of hourly wages. Terms can be discussed per project.

title: Senior Video Creator – Modded Minecraft (Remote, Paid Per Video)
description:
About us

We run a growing network of YouTube and TikTok channels, including a large Minecraft channel built around mod and modpack guides. Our content is search-driven: we make videos that help people find, install and enjoy modded Minecraft. You'd be joining a small, friendly team of creators.



The role

We're hiring one Senior Creator to lead content on our Modded Minecraft channel. You'll create clear, engaging guide-style videos on mods and modpacks, and you'll set the standard for quality on the Minecraft side of the business. Modded Minecraft is the priority. If there's no Minecraft work available, you may be given videos on other games.



What you'll do

Play, learn and film modded Minecraft (mods, modpacks, progression, tips and guides)

Produce videos to our format, following our scripts, briefs and templates

Keep a steady, reliable output of videos each week

Follow our SEO-led approach: topics, titles and structure that people actually search for

Give feedback to help us improve our Minecraft content process



What we're looking for

Strong modded Minecraft knowledge, or the ability to pick up a new modpack quickly.

Experience making gameplay or tutorial videos would be a plus but not essential.

Clear, confident communication, with good English

Reliable and organised, with a PC able to run modpacks and record smoothly

Comfortable working independently and meeting deadlines

Nice to have: experience with guide or SEO content, familiarity with NeoForge and Fabric modpacks



Training

You'll get training on how we make modded Minecraft content, and you'll be guided on our workflow and standards.

Videos will often be very short, meaning you can pump out many per hour.



Pay

$1 USD per video (videos are often 1-3 mins long of raw footage). We do all editing and processing - you just film.

Paid weekly via Wise

Consistent work is available for the right person



Hours and location

Fully remote, flexible hours, working to agreed weekly video targets.



How to apply

Send us:



A short voice recording of the following script: 

"Hi, My name is (Enter Name). The best way to find diamonds in Minecraft would be to go down to at least y-level 12 and then strip mine. Using mass mining like tnt can also be helpful."





A Link to any relevant portfolio if you have one. 

A short note on your modded Minecraft experience (favourite modpacks, how long you've played)

Your general availability



Please put "Senior Creator" in the subject line or title of your application. We review everything and will reply to shortlisted applicants.

title: Full Stack Developer (AI-Assisted Development)
description:
Dear Applicants,



Full Stack Developer (AI-Assisted Development) – We're Hiring! 



Join our team of skilled developers who code well and build faster with AI. You will use tools like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to ship features, tools, automations and websites for our e-commerce and local retail service brands, with everything tested, secure and reliable before it goes live.



IMPORTANT: We value responsible, self-motivated people who take ownership of their work and can deliver quality work with minimal supervision.



Job Scope:

• Use AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor) daily to plan, write, test and review code

• Build AI-powered tools, automations and features using LLM APIs (such as Claude or OpenAI), for example content generation, data clean-up, reporting and workflow automation

• Build and maintain features, custom apps and integrations for our e-commerce brands across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and Amazon

• Build and update brand websites and landing pages (Shopify, Wix and WordPress), including outlet location pages, pricing pages and campaign pages

• Set up enquiry and sign-up forms that feed into our CRM and WhatsApp, plus tracking and SEO basics (Google Analytics, Search Console, ad pixels)

• Make every page fast, mobile-friendly and easy to use, and create simple page visuals with AI tools using our design guidelines

• Review and test all code, AI-written or not, before it goes
 staging first, code review, and no secrets or keys in code

• Write clear documentation so non-technical teammates can use and update what you build



You should have:

• At least 3 years of full stack experience: front end (HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript, React or similar) and back end (Node.js, Python or PHP)

• Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgement to check, test and correct their output

• Experience building features or automations with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or similar)

• Experience with REST or GraphQL APIs, SQL databases and a clean Git workflow

• A good eye for clean, mobile-friendly pages

• Clear written English, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical teammates

• A plus: Shopify development (Liquid, Admin API), and experience with Wix or WordPress



You do not need to be a graphic designer. Visuals can be created with AI tools using our design guidelines.



Note:

• Full-time basis – 40 hrs/week

• Monday to Friday

• 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holidays Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included



IMPORTANT: When applying, please provide:

• Your CV/Resume

• A short video introduction of yourself and why you think you're a good fit

• Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application

• Links to 2 to 3 projects you built (GitHub, live apps or websites), with a short note on your role in each, plus one example of something you built with AI tools: what it was, which tools you used, and what you had to fix or check yourself



Applications without the above points will be less considered.



P.S. Please format your replies in point form according to the items asked above, e.g.:

My resume is here:

Video introduction here:

I am currently doing... / I am leaving because...

Here are my projects and my AI example...



The more information you provide in your initial application, the better.





Best regards,

Loo Yi

title: Digital Marketing & Paid Media Specialist – Meta Ads and Google Ads
description:
Digital Marketing & Paid Media Specialist – Meta Ads and Google Ads



About the Position



We are looking for a skilled Digital Marketing Specialist to join our remote team and manage paid advertising activities across multiple digital platforms.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads, understands performance marketing, and can use data-driven insights to improve campaign effectiveness and achieve business objectives.



Key Responsibilities



Plan, launch, and manage advertising campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.



Develop marketing strategies aligned with business goals.



Monitor advertising budgets and campaign performance.



Research target audiences, market trends, and competitors.



Optimize campaigns to improve conversions and advertising efficiency.



Conduct A/B testing on ad creatives, messaging, and landing pages.



Analyze marketing data and prepare regular performance reports.



Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign results.



Requirements



At least 2 years of experience in digital marketing or paid advertising.



Practical experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns.



Knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.



Understanding of customer acquisition strategies and digital marketing funnels.



Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.



Ability to manage projects independently and meet deadlines.



Good organizational skills and attention to detail.



Position Details



Employment Type: Full-Time.



Work Location: Remote.



Monthly Salary: $1,500–$2,500 USD, depending on experience and qualifications.

How to Apply



Please submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph and include:



Your updated CV/Resume.



A summary of your digital marketing experience and technical skills.



Examples of successful advertising campaigns you have personally managed.

We look forward to reviewing your application.

title: Senior Meta Media Buyer + Account Infrastructure (Restricted E-Commerce)
description:
About us

We're a small performance marketing agency running Meta ads for e-commerce brands in restricted categories (mushrooms, peptides, CBD/cannabis accessories). One of our clients runs 5 brands and we're scaling toward $1M/month in revenue, so we need someone who can both build the account infrastructure and run the buying.



What you'll do

Infrastructure

- Buy and set up FB profiles, business managers and ad accounts from suppliers

- Set up AdsPower profiles and proxies

- Handle card verification, identity/selfie checkpoints and appeals

- Install pixels/CAPI and set up cloaked links

- Replace disabled accounts fast and keep a backup supply ready for every brand



Media buying

- Launch and relaunch campaigns across many ad accounts (horizontal scaling)

- Run creative testing and scale winners

- Write creative briefs for our designer

- Send a short end-of-shift report: what's live, pending and blocked



Requirements

- 2+ years running Meta ads in restricted/grey-hat niches

- Hands-on experience buying and building accounts in AdsPower or another antidetect browser

- Experience with cloaking and with spreading spend across many accounts

- Proof of results: screenshots of accounts you've scaled

- Reliable: stable internet, backup power, shows up on time every shift

- Must overlap 9 AM-1 PM Pacific (12 AM-4 AM Philippine time) every weekday



Pay

Up to $2,000 USD/month depending on experience, paid twice a month via Payoneer, with a monthly performance bonus. 30-day probation.



How to apply

Start your application with the word SCALE and answer:

1. What's the most monthly ad spend you've scaled a single brand to on Meta, and in what niche?

2. Walk us through taking purchased profiles to a live ad: AdsPower setup, business manager, ad account, payment and first launch.

3. Which account suppliers and cloaking tools have you used?

4. A business manager gets disabled mid-scale. What do you do in the first hour?

5. What hours (Philippine time) can you work, and are you currently working for anyone else?

title: Junior Recruiter / Account Coordinator
description:
Remote | Philippines |  Full-Time

About the Opportunity

We are a U.S.-based technology and staffing services company seeking a highly motivated, organized, and resourceful individual to join our team as a Junior Recruiter / Account Coordinator.

You will work directly with a U.S.-based manager, supporting recruitment, business development, client relations, and day-to-day business operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term professional career with an American company, gain international business experience, and develop valuable skills in recruiting, technology staffing, sales, and account management.



We are looking for someone who is eager to learn, takes initiative, communicates effectively, and genuinely wants to grow with our company.



Key Responsibilities

Recruiting & Talent Acquisition

• Source qualified candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, online databases, and other recruiting platforms.

• Review résumés and identify candidates who meet specific job requirements.

• Communicate with prospective candidates and conduct initial screenings.

• Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.

• Create, publish, and maintain online job postings.

• Maintain organized records of candidates, job openings, and recruiting activities.

• Help achieve weekly recruiting and interview goals.

• Learn to recruit candidates across various technology and professional services sectors, including IT infrastructure, cloud technology, networking, desktop support, and project management.

Business Development & Client Relations

• Research prospective companies, clients, and business opportunities.

• Identify potential business contacts and decision-makers through LinkedIn and other online resources.

• Assist with professional
 outreach and follow-up communications.

• Help maintain relationships with existing and prospective clients.

• Support sales and account management activities.

• Learn to identify potential staffing and technology service opportunities.

Administrative & Operational Support

• Work directly with your manager to help organize priorities and ongoing assignments.

• Maintain accurate candidate and client records.

• Track recruitment activities, outstanding tasks, and follow-ups.

• Prepare reports, spreadsheets, and other business-related documents.

• Assist with special projects and other administrative responsibilities as needed.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, organization, and efficiency.

Qualifications

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong interpersonal and professional communication skills.

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Strong online research skills and the ability to find information independently.

• Comfortable using Microsoft Office, LinkedIn, and other online business tools.

• Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Reliable, professional, and responsive.

• Willingness to learn about technology, recruitment, and business development.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• 0–2 years of experience in recruitment, staffing, virtual assistance, sales, customer service, business development, or BPO.

• Experience working with U.S.-based or international companies.

• Familiarity with LinkedIn recruiting or lead generation.

• Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS) or customer relationship management (CRM) software.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required.

Fresh graduates and ambitious early-career professionals are encouraged to apply. Previous recruiting experience is helpful but not essential.

Who We Are Looking For

Beyond experience and qualifications, we are looking for someone who is:

• Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.

• Naturally curious and resourceful.

• An effective communicator.

• Comfortable asking thoughtful questions.

• Able to take ownership of assignments and follow through.

• Open to constructive feedback and professional development.

• Interested in building a long-term working relationship.

We value intelligence, initiative, integrity, consistency, and a genuine desire to grow professionally.

What We Offer

• Fully remote work from the Philippines.

• Direct collaboration with U.S.-based management.

• International business and professional experience.

• Professional development and opportunities to learn new skills.

• Exposure to the U.S. technology and staffing industries.

• Potential for full-time employment and increased responsibilities.

• Opportunity to grow into a more senior recruiting or account management position.

How to Apply

Please submit the following:

1. Your updated résumé.

2. A brief introduction about yourself and your professional goals.

3. A description of any relevant professional experience.

4. Your expected monthly compensation in PHP for a part-time position.

5. Your availability and ability to work during U.S. business hours, if required.

6. A short, 1–2 minute video introduction in English explaining why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Production Coordinator
description:
We are an independent film production seeking a highly organized, proactive Production Coordinator to assist the Director and Producer during pre-production and production of an upcoming feature film shooting in New York and New Hampshire.



This is a remote position, but you will be working closely with a U.S.-based filmmaking team and should be available for regular overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

title: Experienced E-Commerce Sales  $5/hr
description:
Let's get one thing straight: this position isn't for beginners.



We're looking for someone who already understands sales, knows how to handle prospects, and can confidently close deals.



We're offering a $5/hour base rate because we want someone who can bring real sales experience to the table.



What you'll be doing:



This is a high-output sales position. Your job is to generate revenue, not fill your day with random admin tasks.



Your responsibilities include:



Prospecting and reaching out to potential clients.



Working with cold and warm leads.



Pitching our offers through calls,
s, and direct messages.



Identifying customer pain points and presenting solutions.



Handling objections and negotiating with prospects.



Following up strategically instead of letting opportunities go cold.



Closing deals and consistently improving your sales numbers.



We want someone who knows how to move a conversation forward and confidently ask for the sale.



What you need to bring:



1. Proven Sales Experience



You understand sales psychology, pitching, objection handling, follow-up strategies, and closing techniques.



2. Real E-Commerce Experience



You know how e-commerce businesses operate, how online stores generate revenue, and the challenges business owners face.



You should be comfortable having actual business conversations with e-commerce prospects.



3. Numbers to Back It Up



We don't want to hear that you're a "natural salesperson" without anything to support it.



Show us your:



Previous sales results.



Closing rates.



Revenue generated.



Average deal size.



Biggest deal closed.



If you don't have exact numbers for everything, explain what you can confidently verify.



4. Independent and Competitive



You take ownership of your pipeline, know how to manage your time, and constantly look for ways to improve your performance.



Compensation



$5/hour base pay



Strong commission structure



Performance-based earning potential



We value people who can consistently bring results.



How to Apply



Here's your first test.



Put "BUILT TO CLOSE" as the very first line of your application.



If you miss this instruction, we'll assume you didn't read the job post.



Also, include a link to a 2-minute Loom video with your camera ON.



In your video, cover these points:



Your Previous Offers: What exactly have you sold? Tell us the actual product or service, its price point, and your target customers.



Your Sales Numbers: What were your closing rates, revenue generated, and biggest deals?



Your E-Commerce Background: What experience do you have working with e-commerce businesses?



Your Closing Process: Walk us through how you approach a prospect, handle objections, and close a deal.



Why You? What makes you the person we should hire instead of the other experienced salespeople applying?



Be specific. We want examples, not rehearsed answers.



If your Loom shows us you know what you're doing, we'll move straight to an interview.



We're looking for closers, not people who just want to put "Sales Representative" on their resume.

title: Part-Time Senior Content Marketing & Lead Generation Strategist
description:
Crown Realty Experts is an established U.S. real estate brokerage and property management company seeking an experienced marketing strategist to strengthen our video marketing and turn audience attention into qualified inquiries.



We have an existing video library and a team that supports content production. We need someone who can evaluate our results, identify opportunities, and give the team clear direction to improve performance.



What you will do

- Audit our existing videos, social media channels, and available analytics.

- Research relevant competitors and explain what we can learn from their content, positioning, and lead generation.

- Recommend improvements to topics, hooks, messaging, presentation, calls to action, and distribution.

- Build a practical marketing plan and content calendar tied to business goals.

- Develop the path from viewing our content to making an inquiry, including lead capture and follow-up.

- Give our production team clear briefs, priorities, deadlines, and feedback.

- Track qualified inquiries, appointments, and other meaningful results, then recommend adjustments.

- Provide a brief weekly report covering completed work, results, obstacles, and next steps.

What we are looking for

- Demonstrated experience developing and executing content marketing strategies that generated leads.

- Strong understanding of video marketing, social media analytics, and conversion.

- Ability to translate research into specific recommendations and oversee implementation.

- Excellent written English, sound judgment, and clear communication.

- Dependable availability for 20 hours every week, with agreed meeting times overlapping U.S. Central business hours.

- Ownership of deadlines and advance communication about planned absences.

Experience with real estate, professional services, GoHighLevel, CRM systems, and
 automation is a plus.



Your initial priorities



Review our existing content and performance, assess relevant competitors, and deliver an actionable marketing plan for January 2027. The plan should identify target audiences, content priorities, production responsibilities, lead capture and follow-up steps, and measures of success.



How to apply



Please use “Marketing Strategist – Crown Realty Experts” as your application subject and include:

1. Your résumé and portfolio.

2. Two examples of campaigns you personally helped lead. Explain your responsibilities, the results, and how those results were measured.

3. A short description of how you would evaluate a company that published videos consistently for a year without generating business.

4. Your proposed weekly schedule, including availability in U.S. Central Time.

5. Your hourly rate, earliest start date, other work commitments, and any planned absences through January 2027.

We are looking for someone who can bring strategic judgment, dependable execution, and measurable progress to our marketing efforts.

title: Full Time Video Editor
description:
Are you a detail-obsessed video editor who knows what makes someone stop scrolling?



We're a fast-growing digital marketing agency, and we're hiring our first full-time Video Editor. You'll turn raw footage into scroll-stopping
 and Instagram ads, clean corporate pieces and polished motion graphics. If you care about every frame, understand how video ads actually perform, and want to own the creative side of a growing team, read on.



WARNING: Applying on this job platform DOES NOT confirm your application. To apply, fill out the application form here: 



What You'll Be Doing:



- Editing short-form video ads for Meta 
 & Instagram) in vertical, square and landscape formats (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)

- Building hooks for the first 3 seconds, adding captions and on-screen text, and pacing edits for retention

- Creating motion graphics: animated text, lower thirds, logo animations, transitions and simple explainer elements

- 2+ years of professional video editing experience

- A portfolio showing video ads, motion graphics and colour grading work (required to apply)

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve

- Working knowledge of After Effects (or similar) for motion graphics

- Understanding of video ad best practices: hooks, pacing, captions, safe zones and platform specs

- Sharp attention to detail: you catch the typo, the audio pop and the colour shift before anyone else does

- Able to take feedback and turn revisions around quickly

- Fluent in English (written and verbal)

- Comfortable with Google Drive, Slack and Loom

- Experience at an agency or with performance marketing is a bonus

- Experience with CapCut, AI video tools or basic graphic design (Canva/Photoshop) is a bonus



What You Get:



- $500–$1000/mo starting salary (depending on experience)

- Full-time, long-term role

- 100% remote with flexible hours

- Steady creative volume, so you'll always have new projects

- Room to grow into a Lead Editor or Creative Director role as the team scales

- Direct access to ad performance data, so you can see what your edits actually achieve

- Paid time off & Bonus Incentives



Warning: This Role Is NOT for You If…



- You need someone checking your work every step of the way

- "Good enough" is good enough for you

- You only want to edit long-form YouTube content or cinematic films

- You don't like revisions or feedback



Apply Now If You're:



An editor who cares about results, not just how the video looks

Someone who wants to own the creative side of a growing agency

Eager to sharpen your skills in performance-driven video

title: Youtube Senior Video Editor
description:
Hey Editors! It’s Time to Level Up. Ready to Take Your Editing Career Further?



We are looking for an expert-level YouTube Video Editor who can create premium, retention-focused long-form content for top creators and brands. This role is best suited for editors who understand high-quality YouTube storytelling in the style of channels such as Vox, Johnny Harris, Cleo Abram, and other documentary/explainer-style creators. We are not looking for basic editors, short-form-only editors, or editors who simply add cuts and captions. We are looking for someone with strong creative judgment, technical skill, and the ability to turn raw footage and direction into a polished, engaging, and thoughtful YouTube video. The ideal editor understands pacing, story structure, audience retention, visual clarity, motion graphics, sound design, and how every editing choice affects the viewer’s experience.



Responsibilities



Edit high-quality long-form YouTube videos for creators, brands, and educational content.

Build strong hooks that make viewers want to keep watching.

Shape raw footage into a clear and engaging story.

Use B-roll, archival footage, graphics, music, sound design, and visual references intentionally.

Create clean motion graphics, maps, text animations, callouts, and visual explanations when needed.

Improve pacing, flow, clarity, and retention throughout the video.

Follow creative direction while also bringing your own strong editorial judgment.

Apply feedback quickly and professionally.

Work with creative leads, producers, and post-production teams to meet high creative standards.

Deliver polished edits on time in a fast-moving YouTube-first environment.



Qualifications



Strong experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

Expert-level skill in Adobe Premiere Pro.

Expert-level skill in Adobe After Effects and motion graphics.

Good understanding of Photoshop or other Adobe Creative Suite tools.

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts.

Ability to create documentary, explainer, talking-head, educational, or creator-style edits.

Strong use of B-roll, archival footage, visual references, graphics, sound design, and music.

Understanding of audience retention, viewer engagement, and YouTube performance.

Experience editing high-performing or high-quality content for creators, agencies, brands, or media companies.

Ability to work with feedback, revisions, and tight deadlines.

Strong attention to detail and clean technical execution.

Reliable computer/workstation setup and strong internet connection.



This Role Is Not For



Entry-level editors.

Editors with only short-form reel experience.

Editors with only wedding, corporate, event, or basic social media editing experience.

Editors who are not comfortable with long-form YouTube content.

Editors who only follow instructions but do not bring creative judgment.

Editors who cannot work with feedback or tight deadlines.

Editors who do not have strong Premiere Pro and After Effects skills.



Benefits



Work from anywhere! We’re a 100% remote team.

A quarterly wellness reimbursement

Unlimited paid time off

Unlimited sick and bereavement leave.

Working for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact.

Unlimited reimbursement on book purchases for self-education.

Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements.

Working directly with some of the largest brands on the planet.



Additionally, Dragonfruit is highly committed to offering all our team members opportunities for growth and mobility within the company. This could include moving up to Lead Short-Form or Long-Form Editor, Director of the Editing Department, Post-Production Supervisor, or even Creative Director or beyond! (Of course, all of these positions come with pay increases.)

title: E-Commerce Backoffice Assistant – Listings & Product Management
description:
About Us

We are Bluespoon GmbH, a fast-growing German e-commerce company specialising in premium tableware under our brand Sänger Geschirr. Our products are listed on Amazon, OTTO, Home24, Shopify, XXXLutz and more. Our team is based in Germany – you work remotely from the Philippines.

Our products can only be sold if they are correctly listed, fully populated and active across all channels. You make sure that is the case – every single day.



The Role

You are responsible for ensuring that our product data across all sales channels is complete, accurate and active. You create new listings, check existing ones for errors and policy violations, activate products after availability dates and support the build-out and maintenance of our growing product range.

This role is ideal for someone with a feel for e-commerce platforms, a structured working style and a genuine interest in how online product data works.



Your Responsibilities



- Create new product listings in JTL Wawi with all required master data: SKU, EAN, product name, category, price, weight, attributes

- Upload products and product data to Amazon and verify correct processing and visibility

- Activate and verify listings across all channels (Amazon, OTTO, Home24, Shopify, XXXLutz) after availability dates

- Monitor Amazon product listings daily for policy violations (e.g. broken variant families) – initiate corrections following documented processes

- Check Prime badge status weekly and resolve any missing badges

- Maintain B2B pricing rules on Amazon for all relevant products

- Reactivate listings after availability dates on all relevant platforms

- Support EPR compliance documentation at channel and product level

- Support OTTO Rich Content creation for product detail pages



Additional Backoffice Tasks:

- Monitor price changes in the pricing tool and verify transfer across all channels

- Create manual orders for B2B customers and influencers in JTL Wawi

- Coordinate weekly stock availability with the warehouse partner



What We Are Looking For



Must-Have:

- Structured, precise working style – you maintain data carefully and completely

- Good English skills (C1) – for internal communication and platform work

- Good Excel skills (data entry, formulas, structured input)

- Reliable and self-directed in executing recurring processes

- Stable internet connection, professional working environment

- Background in e-commerce, online retail or digital product management



Nice-to-Have:

- German language skills (strong plus – systems and documents are often in German)

- Experience with Amazon Seller Central – listings, variants, content, policies

- Knowledge of JTL Wawi or comparable ERP / warehouse management systems

- Understanding of marketplace logic (visibility, categories, attributes, compliance)





What We Offer

- Part-time remote position – work from the Philippines

- Long-term position with room to grow into more responsibilities

- Clearly documented processes – you will always know what comes next

- Direct collaboration with a professional German team



How to Apply



Please send us:

- Your CV / resume (in English)

- A short cover letter (3–5 sentences) explaining why you are a good fit for this role

- A 1–2 minute intro video



Applications without all three items will not be considered.

title: Instagram DM Setter - Paid 30-Day Trial (Sports Vision Training)
description:
ABOUT US

Shah NeuroVision trains athletes' vision, reaction and decision speed, working with everyone from invested youth athletes and their parents to college and professional players. Our Instagram is where most of our new athletes find us, and we're building a small DM team to handle those conversations.



THE ROLE

You'll run conversations in our Instagram DMs, writing from our account in our voice. You'll reach out to people who already engage with our content, learn what they're working toward, and guide the right ones to a free assessment or an evaluation. An AI tool helps draft replies; you step in wherever a real human touch is needed and keep every conversation accurate, friendly and pressure-free.



HOW THE TRIAL WORKS

We're hiring three setters for a paid 30-day trial. Each setter earns base pay for the trial plus $30 for every evaluation they book. At the end of the 30 days, we keep the setter with the best results and offer them the ongoing role, with the same $30 bonus per evaluation.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH DAY

- Review our story viewers, likers and commenters, and send about 30 personalized openers a day using each person's name and sport.

- Follow up once on unanswered openers, then close them out.

- Ask good questions to find the athlete's goals and the main thing holding them back.

- Once there's a real need, share the right next step (our video or our free Decision Speed Snapshot) in a no-pressure way.

- Point people to the free resources in our bio.

- Flag anything outside your lane to the owner: health or medical questions, verified or pro accounts, and anyone who may be under 18 (confirm who is writing first).

- Log every conversation in our DM tracker and send a short weekly summary.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent written English that sounds natural and warm, never scripted.

- A daily Instagram user who is comfortable with DMs, stories and profiles.

- Experience as an appointment setter, DM setter or social media VA (preferred).

- Interest in sports. Knowing baseball, softball, football, basketball, soccer, tennis or cricket is a plus.

- Comfortable working with AI tools and Google Sheets.

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work.

- Available during US Pacific business hours (8 AM to 12 PM PT).



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Hours: part-time, 20 hours a week

- Pay: $5 to $6 per hour + $30 for each evaluation you book

- Openings: 3 setters for a paid 30-day trial. The top performer is kept on for the ongoing role.

- Start date: As soon as possible



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include all of the following. Applications missing any part won't be reviewed.

1. Start your message with the words VISION SETTER so we know you read the whole post.

2. A short intro: your setter or DM experience and the sports you follow.

3. Answers to these three questions:

   a) A parent of a high school pitcher just liked one of our reels. Write the exact opener you would send.

   b) Someone's first reply is "how much does it cost?" What do you write back?

   c) A conversation goes quiet after two messages. What do you do?

4. A link to a 1 to 2 minute voice or video recording introducing yourself in English.

title: Short Form Editor
description:
Shah Neurovision Sports Training (NeuroVision Edge) teaches athletes the vision and brain side of performance — reaction time, tracking, game IQ. We publish educational Reels on Instagram 
 28K+ followers and climbing). Our content is calm, credible, and genuinely useful — not hype, not motivational fluff. We're scaling our output on a clear path toward 1M followers, and the editor is the engine that makes that possible.

What you'll do

Edit 14–15 short-form videos per week — Instagram Reels, 30–60 seconds, from raw talking-head footage.

Cut podcast footage into Reels — pull standalone clips from our podcast episodes.

Add clean animated captions and text overlays, accurately synced to the audio.

Edit for retention — simple b-roll, zooms, and hard cuts that hold attention, especially in the first 3 seconds.

Build on-screen graphics — hook text, simple stat/drill callouts, and a closing “save this” card.

Light cleanup — basic color and audio so every video looks and sounds sharp.

Export to spec — 9:16, correct resolution, delivered on an agreed schedule.

Hold the format — keep a consistent look across every video using our template.

The format you'll work in

So you know exactly what you're signing up for: our Reels are not complex VFX projects. They're talking-head delivery, animated captions, athlete famous or current athlete events b-roll, and simple text graphics. The skill we care about is retention editing — pacing, cuts, and hook framing — not motion-design wizardry. Once you know our template, each video should be fast to turn around. We'll give you a clear style guide and example videos to match.

What we're looking for

2+ years editing short-form video (Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts).

A portfolio of short-form work — send your strongest Reels or TikToks.

Fast, accurate captioning and text-overlay skills.

Strong retention instincts — you understand hooks, pacing, and when to cut or zoom.

Tool proficiency — CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.

Good written English — you'll be placing on-screen captions, so accuracy matters.

Reliable turnaround — you hit deadlines and flag issues early.

Self-directed — once you know the format, you run with minimal hand-holding.

Nice to have

Interest in or knowledge of sports.

explanatory motion graphics — animated text, simple lower-thirds.

Experience editing for educational or talking-head creators.

A feel for current short-form trends and audio conventions.

Logistics

Full-time, fully remote.

Compensation: based on experience. 

Hours: a few hours of overlap with US Pacific time for handoffs — otherwise flexible.

Ongoing, long-term role with room to grow as the channel scales.

Start: as soon as we find the right fit.

How to apply

Please do all three of these — applications missing the test edit won't be reviewed:

Send your portfolio — links to 3–5 short-form videos you personally edited.

Answer one question — in a sentence or two, tell us the single best hook you've ever cut, and why it worked.

Complete the paid test edit below.

The paid test edit

We respect your time, so the test is paid whether or not we move forward.

We'll send you one raw talking-head clip (about 60–90 seconds).

Edit it into a finished ~40-second Instagram Reel: animated captions, a strong hook treatment in the first 3 seconds, 2–3 simple b-roll or zoom 
nts, and a closing “save this” card.

Turn it around within 3 days.

We pay $30 USD for the completed test. 

We're judging three things: turnaround speed, caption and text quality, and whether you matched our format without needing detailed direction.

To apply, reply with your portfolio, your hook answer, and confirm you're available for the test edit.

title: Tutor - CRE Underwriting & Financial Modeling
description:
I'm a commercial real estate professional specializing in multifamily investment sales. I'm seeking a part-time private tutor to teach me multifamily underwriting and financial modeling the way it's taught in a university-level real estate development program — structured, rigorous, and built around a proper textbook curriculum.



This is a teaching engagement, not a one-off training session. I want someone who can guide me from fundamentals through a complete, self-built multifamily underwriting and waterfall model, with assessments along the way to prove I've actually learned the material.



At a glance:

• Role: Private tutor / instructor

• Schedule: Twice per week (two 60–90 minute remote sessions)

• Format: Fully remote via Zoom/Teams with screen sharing and Excel work-alongs

• Rate: $15/hour USD (paid via Wise)

• Start date: Immediate, upon successful interview



What You'll Be Teaching:

A structured curriculum of your own proposal, modeled on a university real estate development / real estate finance program, working out of a recognized textbook (e.g., Peter Linneman's Real Estate Finance and Investments or comparable). You will propose the syllabus and textbook in your application.



Core topic areas:

1. Foundations — time value of money, NPV/IRR/MIRR, cap rates, NOI, basis points, leverage concepts

2. Multifamily underwriting — rent rolls, market rents, vacancy and loss to lease, operating expenses and expense ratios, capital expenditures, debt terms (amortization, DSCR, loan sizing), investor pro forma conventions

3. Financial modeling in Excel — building a complete multifamily acquisition model from scratch, with sensitivity tables, scenario analysis, and clean formatting standards

4. Waterfalls and syndication math — preferred returns, return of capital, catch-up tranches, promote/carried interest, IRR-hurdle-based distribution waterfalls for LP/GP structures

5. Development topics — land/entitlement basics, ground-up feasibility analysis, construction budgeting and draws, permanent loan takeout, developer profit and developer waterfalls



Curriculum Structure Requirements:

• University-style curriculum: You will map out a semester-style syllabus with weekly topics tied to assigned textbook readings before we begin.

• Work out of a textbook: Each session should build on assigned reading and problem sets.

• Quizzes: Short quizzes at regular mile markers (roughly every 3–4 weeks) covering prior material.

• Tests/exams: Longer assessments at major milestones (mid-program and capstone), including a hands-on modeling exam where I build or repair a model under time constraint.

• Capstone project: A complete multifamily acquisition model built by me from scratch, including an equity waterfall tab, reviewed and graded by you.



Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience underwriting or acquiring multifamily assets (e.g., work at an acquisitions shop, appraisal firm, brokerage, developer, or lending institution)

• Advanced, demonstrable Excel modeling skills (clean formula design, scenario toggles, waterfall logic — no copy-paste templates)

• Practical familiarity with distribution waterfall math and GP/LP structures

• Prior tutoring, teaching, or training experience required

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and dual-screen setup for screen-share lessons

• Ability to commit to a fixed twice-weekly schedule for at least 3–6 months



Nice to Have:

• Familiarity with US markets and conventions (Argus, CoStar, or similar exposure is a plus but not required — this course is Excel-native)

• Experience building development / construction-draw models

• Textbook-honed problem-solving: you should be comfortable assigning and grading exercises from a real estate finance text



To Apply:

Please send

1. A resume

2. A brief summary of your multifamily underwriting/modeling experience (deals, roles, tools)

3. A proposed curriculum outline: the textbook you'd use, a week-by-week topic list

4. A sample of your modeling work (screenshots welcome; formulas visible)

5. Your availability (EST) and confirmation you can commit to two sessions per week

title: Financial Controller

title: Orthodontic Virtual Assistant (Remote -  $7 to $8 per hour)
description:
Dental office or practice experience required



Orthodontic Virtual Assistant. For someone whose voice makes a nervous parent smile before they ever walk through our door.



Our best days start with good music playing low and a phone that keeps ringing in the best way. Every caller

hears someone who sounds genuinely glad they called. By the end of the day, people who dialed in unsure have

a first visit on the calendar and are already looking forward to it. Nobody is rushing. Nobody sounds like they're

reading a script. Dr. B and the team are in sync, and the day moves like a great set: everyone knows their part,

and the whole room sounds better because of it. You'll be working virtually, but you are still part of that room.



We are small by choice. That means you will know our patients and families by name, they will know your voice,

and the people you work with will notice when you do something great and say so out loud. We're a brand new

practice in Green Hills, Nashville, and you will be one of the very first voices people hear. We're building

something we are really proud of, one great phone call at a time!



Everything we do runs on five values we call MAGIC: Mastery, Authenticity, Growth, Integrity, and Compassion.



They aren't a poster on the wall. They're how we show up for our patients and for each other, and they're what

we look for in every person who joins us.



Who thrives here

You're someone who lives our five values without being told, and who lights up when the phone rings:



Mastery. You take pride in a clean, well run schedule and a perfectly confirmed appointment, and you would

rather ask "why do we do it this way?" than guess. New software and a really good system give you a little

thrill, and insurance language sounds like something you'd enjoy learning, not something to fear.



Authenticity. You're the same warm, upbeat person on a call as you are with your best friend. Your energy

is natural, not performed. You can make a worried parent and a shy teenager both feel like the most

interesting caller of the day, and you tell the truth kindly, whether that's "that time is taken, but here's a great

option" or "here's what I'd do differently."



Growth. You're curious, you welcome change, and you hear "small team" and think "my ideas will be

heard," not "that sounds like a lot."



Integrity. You do the right thing when no one is watching. When you promise a callback, you call back. You

show up on time and ready because the first caller of the day is counting on you, and when you make a

mistake you say so and fix it.



Compassion. You can hear the worry in someone's voice and slow down before anyone asks you to. You

listen first, because every patient and family calls with different needs and different questions.

Your phone presence is the job. A caller meets us through your voice, and a warm, upbeat, confident

one is the best first impression we could ask for. If you light up on a call, we want to meet you.



Dental experience is required, and orthodontic experience is a bonus. Phone based customer service

experience helps too. Insurance experience is not required, because we will train you. Energy and heart are the

things we can't teach, and everything else we can. If you have both, we want to hear from you!



What you'll do

This role is more than scheduling. Here is what your days cover, and we will train you on the insurance side.



Patient Communication

Make outbound calls to patients as needed

Communicate professionally with patients and families

Follow scripts and practice protocols while sounding natural

Escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate team member

Maintain a positive, patient first tone on all calls



Observation and Follow Up Scheduling

Contact patients who need to schedule follow up appointments

Support observation recall and pending appointment follow up

Speak with patients in a warm, professional, and helpful way

Help patients understand next steps and get scheduled

Document call outcomes and follow up needs accurately



Insurance Verification

Verify dental and orthodontic insurance eligibility and benefits

Confirm coverage, deductibles, maximums, waiting periods, and limitations

Complete accurate insurance breakdowns

Document insurance details clearly in the practice management system

Flag missing, unclear, or incorrect insurance information for follow up



Claims Follow Up

Follow up on unpaid, denied, rejected, or delayed claims

Contact insurance companies as needed to check claim status

Review EOBs and identify payment discrepancies

Document claim updates clearly for the team

Help keep insurance and billing workflows moving accurately



What a star looks like at six months

Here are the three things on your scorecard. Hit these and you're not just doing the job, you're the reason our

days feel the way they do.

1. Every call feels like the best call of the patient's day. Phones are answered quickly and warmly, new

patient inquiries turn into booked first visits, and callers feel heard before they hang up. Families mention

your voice by name, and so do our reviews.

2. The schedule is full, smooth, and honest. Appointments are confirmed, reschedules are handled with a

smile, and missed visits get a friendly follow up. Dr. B's day flows without gaps or chaos, and the team never

wonders what's coming next.

3. You've grown into the insurance side and made us better. After our training, you can explain the basics

of orthodontic benefits to a family in plain words and know exactly when to bring in a teammate. You've also

brought us at least one idea that improved how we answer calls or run the schedule, and we put it in place.



Straight talk, up front

We'd rather you know everything now than be surprised later.



The schedule. This is a full time virtual assistant role, 40 hours a week, working remotely from your own

home office in the Philippines on US Central Time hours to match our Nashville office. That means a night

shift on your end, so this role is for Philippines based candidates who are comfortable working nights. You'll

be a true part of our team, not a faceless voice on a line. Your exact hours: 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Central

Time, Monday through Friday, with a one hour unpaid lunch.



The phone is the job. Much of your day is spent on the phone with patients and insurance companies, both

answering calls and making them. This is not a quiet, heads down,
 only seat. If you would rather avoid

the phone, this isn't the one for you.

Your voice has to come through clearly. You'll need clear, natural, confident spoken English, a quiet

space to work, reliable high speed internet, and a good headset.

We will train you on insurance. You don't need to know it already. You do need to be willing to learn it.

We're new. Some systems are still being built. Some days will be packed and some will be quiet, and

everyone pitches in on whatever needs doing, including the unglamorous stuff.

You'll hear the truth. We'll tell you what's working and what isn't, and we expect the same back.

The pay. $7 to $8 an hour.



How to apply

When you apply, please include one sentence about one time you dealt with an unreasonable or unhappy

person and turned it into a great situation. Write it the way you would say it on the phone, and put it at the very

top of your application message. Without that sentence, we won't be able to consider you.



Please submit the following:

1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A short paragraph describing your experience with:

Dental or orthodontic insurance verification

Patient scheduling or phone communication

3. A list of any dental, orthodontic, billing, or phone systems you have used

4. A short voice or video introduction via Vocaroo, Loom, or a similar platform so we can evaluate phone

readiness and communication style



Subject line: Orthodontic VA: Insurance & Scheduling | [Your Full Name]

 and Google Workspace or Microsoft Office tools to communicate with

title: Appointment Setter | $5 an Hour + $150 Commission | Neutral Accent Only (Voice Sample Required)
description:
Apollo Media

Appointment Setter



Overview

Apollo Media is a marketing company catered toward the kitchen and bathroom remodeling industry. We help business owners by building professional websites, automating customer relationship management, running
 ads, and helping them rank higher on Google. We are looking to hire two experienced cold callers to prospect local American businesses and set appointments for our sales team.



What We're Looking For

2+ years of cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting experience.

Excellent spoken and written American English: clear, neutral, and easy for U.S. business owners to understand.

Confident, professional phone presence and ability to follow a script without sounding robotic or overly "salesy."

Organized and proactive employees who are comfortable managing daily outreach activity with minimal supervision.



What You'll Do

Make outbound cold calls to U.S. kitchen and bathroom remodeling business owners using provided leads and scripts.

Introduce Apollo Media's services and explain how we help remodelers capture more inquiries and book more jobs.

Qualify prospects, handle basic objections, and book qualified discovery calls for our sales team.

Follow up with warm leads and past inquiries.

Maintain accurate records of every call, conversation, and appointment in our CRM (GoHighLevel).

Collaborate with the sales team to refine outreach and improve booking rates.



Performance Expectations

Specific targets will be set after training. Performance is measured on:

Completed outbound calls per day

Booked appointment show rate (those who actually attend)

Organized follow-up completion



Is This Job Right for You?

We'll let you know now, this job is hard. Most of your calls will end in a no, a hang-up, a gatekeeper, or voi
, and you have to keep dialing for the full 4 hours anyway with no one standing over you. Every call is logged and reviewed, and your performance is tracked daily. If you need someone pushing you to stay on task, do not apply. This is for hard workers who are willing and ready to learn and study their sales craft on their own to get better. If you put in the work and work well with us, we will do well by you.



Equipment & Workspace

Reliable power setup with a UPS (uninterruptible power supply) to bridge short outages without dropping calls; backup power for longer interruptions is strongly preferred.

Reliable wired internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps; 50+ Mbps preferred).

Quiet, dedicated workspace for calls.

Quality headset with microphone.

Desktop or laptop computer (Windows 10/11 or macOS).

Backup internet (mobile hotspot or secondary connection) in case of outages.



Compensation & Schedule

Pay: $5 USD per hour, part time

Performance bonus: $150 USD for each qualified appointment that turns into a closed sale.

ADDITIONAL BONUS - Pay Increase: Hit 12+ held demos in a month on your part-time schedule and earn $5.50/hour the next month. Hit 20+ and earn $6/hour the next month.

Hours: Monday to Friday, U.S. 10 AM to 2 PM EST / 11 PM to 3 AM PHT

Breaks: One paid 15-minute break per shift

Remote position



IMPORTANT

This role requires strong, reliable internet and clear English with a neutral accent that U.S. business owners can easily understand. When you apply, upload a voice sample and enter the code word ARTESIAN in the form.

If you do not meet these criteria, please do not apply.

title: Administrative & Customer Service Representative
description:
About the Role



Nunez Agency is looking for a highly capable, intelligent, and experienced Customer Service Representative (CSR) who can adapt quickly, take ownership of responsibilities, and handle a wide range of tasks with minimal supervision. This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who can quickly understand new systems and processes, think independently, solve problems, and deliver accurate results without constant guidance.



You will support a wide range of administrative, customer service, and insurance-related operations, including client communication, quote preparation, policy servicing, renewals, documentation, property valuations, and fiduciary/trust account administration.



No insurance license is required. Training will be provided for agency-specific processes.



Key Responsibilities

1. Client Service & Communication

- Handle incoming client calls and
s professionally and promptly.

- Assist with billing questions, policy inquiries, endorsements, renewals, and cancellations.

- Communicate clearly with clients, insurance carriers, underwriters, lenders, and fiduciary representatives.

- Follow up on pending requests and make sure communication does not fall through the cracks.



2. Insurance Operations & Quote Preparation

- Gather client information and prepare insurance quotes through various carrier portals for licensed agents to review.

- Assist with policy changes, renewals, cancellations, and other service requests.

- Follow up with insurance carriers regarding pending quotes, underwriting requirements, and policy requests.

- Generate and update property valuation reports (Replacement Cost Estimators).

- Collect and organize property photos, applications, inspections, and other underwriting documents.



4. Administrative & Operational Support

- Maintain accurate documentation and properly organize client and property records.

- Verify policy information, named insureds, mortgagees, and loss payees based on approved instructions.

- Track renewals, pending tasks, follow-ups, and deadlines.

- Organize digital files and maintain proper documentation.

- Identify opportunities to improve processes and prevent recurring mistakes.



What We Are Looking For

- Quick Learner: Able to understand new systems, instructions, and processes quickly.

- Intelligent & Resourceful: Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Detail-Oriented: Accurate when handling information, numbers, documents, and records.

- Excellent Communicator: Strong written and spoken English with a professional and positive attitude.

- Fast & Efficient: Good typing speed, computer skills, and ability to work efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.

- Proactive: Takes ownership, follows through, and does not need constant supervision.

- Adaptable: Willing to learn new responsibilities and handle different types of tasks.



Major Plus: Previous experience in P&C insurance, insurance customer service, quoting, policy administration, renewals, or carrier portals.



A strong academic background, excellent academic performance, or proven exceptional performance in previous roles is also highly valued. 



Compensation & Benefits

- $950/month, negotiable based on qualifications and demonstrated ability.

- Team Recognition Program.

- Paid Holidays after 90 days.

- Paid Time Off after 1 year.

- Training and opportunities for growth.



How to Apply

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer, Healthcare Ordering Platform
description:

Remote · Full-time · Long-term contract

We’re a US healthcare company connecting medical clinics—including med spas, weight-loss and wellness practices—with licensed partner pharmacies. Our portal allows clinics to prescribe, place orders, make payments and track shipments. Sales reps use it to manage their assigned clinics.



The front end is designed and largely built. We’re looking for an experienced developer to take ownership of the existing platform, connect it to real data and partner systems, prepare it for launch, and maintain it long-term.

Build and maintain secure APIs and database structures for clinics, users, orders, invoices, payments and commissions.

What we’re looking for

Strong JavaScript or TypeScript skills and experience with React; Next.js is a plus.

Backend development experience with Node.js or Python.

Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks and third-party integrations.

Server-side authentication, authorization and role-based access control.

Experience with deployments, hosting, Git, GitHub and pull requests.

Ability to understand and improve an existing codebase rather than defaulting to a rewrite.

Clear written English, reliable communication and independent problem-solving.

Availability for full-time work with at least four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.
