title: Marketing Assistant
description:
WordPress & Social Media Virtual Assistant



Remote · Approximately 10 hours per week · Ongoing



About D2C



D2C is a shopper, field and brand marketing agency operating across Australia and New Zealand. 

We are looking for a reliable, detail focused Virtual Assistant to keep our website and social channels current, consistent and professionally presented.



The role

You will manage content publishing across our WordPress website, LinkedIn and Instagram, turning supplied copy and imagery into polished, approved posts.

Our target is three core content pieces per week, adapted across all three channels. This means approximately three website uploads, three LinkedIn posts and three Instagram posts, rather than nine separate pieces of original content.

Content will include case studies, company news, campaign highlights and industry insights.



Key responsibilities



WordPress content management

Upload, format and publish case studies, news and insights using our existing website templates. Prepare featured images, headings, links, categories and image alt text. Add basic SEO titles and descriptions where supported, optimise image sizes, and check desktop and mobile presentation before publishing.



LinkedIn and Instagram publishing

Adapt supplied content into captions suited to each platform and D2C’s tone of voice. Resize and crop imagery using existing assets and templates, add appropriate tags and links, and schedule or publish approved posts. Check that published content displays correctly.



Content coordination and quality control

Maintain a simple content calendar covering drafts, approvals and publication dates. Proofread all content, organise assets and flag missing information early. Obtain approval before publishing, particularly for client names, campaign results and imagery. Provide a brief weekly update with published links, outstanding items and time spent.



What we are looking for

• Proven WordPress publishing experience, including formatting articles, managing images and working within existing templates.

• Experience managing business LinkedIn and Instagram accounts, including adapting captions and scheduling organic content.

• Strong written English and attention to detail, with the ability to follow brand guidelines and use British/Australian spelling.

• Basic image editing skills, using Canva or similar tools, plus reliable communication and the ability to meet deadlines independently.



Experience supporting a marketing agency or other business audience would be an advantage. Coding and website development experience are not required.



Working arrangements and scope

The role is expected to require approximately ten hours per week, with flexible scheduling and some availability during Sydney business hours for coordination.



D2C will provide core copy, imagery, brand guidance and approvals. Your focus will be publishing, light copy editing and adapting existing assets.



Original article writing, substantial graphic design, video production, paid advertising, ongoing community management and website development are outside the initial scope. Any additional work or hours must be agreed in advance.



How to apply

Please provide a brief introduction, your hourly rate and currency, time zone, weekly availability and relevant WordPress and social media examples. Explain your specific contribution to each example.



Success in this role means accurate, well presented content published on schedule, with minimal supervision and within the agreed hours.

title: Home Health Coder – ICD-10-CM, OASIS-E2 & PDGM (HCS-D preferred)
description:
About EZ Scribe LLC:

EZ Scribe LLC provides clinical documentation, coding and QA support to U.S. Medicare-certified home health agencies. We are growing our coding team and need a coder who can work accurately with little supervision from day one.



What you will do:

- Code home health periods in ICD-10-CM from SOC, ROC and recert OASIS assessments and referral documents, following the ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines and PDGM rules.

- Choose and sequence primary and secondary diagnoses that the record supports, and avoid codes that return to provider.

- Review OASIS-E2 answers for accuracy against the clinical record, and flag issues to clinicians through the agency's EMR.

- Check that the plan of care matches the diagnoses, orders, disciplines and visit frequencies.

- Help with QA chart reviews when needed.

- Work directly in agency EMRs (WellSky/Kinnser, Axxess, HCHB or similar).



Must have:

- 2+ years coding for U.S. home health agencies (hospital, clinic or pro-fee coding alone does not qualify).

- A current coding credential: HCS-D, BCHH-C, CPC or CCS.

- Strong working knowledge of PDGM, OASIS-E/E2 and the ICD-10-CM guidelines.

- Clear written English for coding notes and queries to U.S. clinicians.

- Reliable internet, a private workspace and availability during U.S. Pacific business hours.

- Willing to pass our HIPAA and cyber security training before getting access to any client system.

- Willing to work only inside our secure cloud workstation, never on a personal computer or phone, and to sign our confidentiality and HIPAA agreements.



Nice to have:

- COS-C

- An RN, PT or OT license

- QA or OASIS review experience

- Hospice coding



How to apply (applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed):

1. Use the subject line "HH Coder – [your full name]".

2. Attach your resume and your coding credential, including the credential number so we can verify it.

3. Answer the five questions below in your own words, without AI tools. Do not include any real patient names, dates or record numbers.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short coding test.



Screening questions:

1. Which home health EMRs have you coded in, for how long, and about how many charts do you code per day?

2. Under PDGM, what five factors place a 30-day period into a payment group?

3. Name two types of diagnosis codes that cause a home health claim to return to provider if listed as primary, with one example code of each.

4. A patient is admitted to home health after ORIF of a traumatic left hip fracture. They also have type 2 diabetes with diabetic polyneuropathy and use insulin daily. Which codes would you assign, in what order, and why?

5. What is the difference between a low and a high comorbidity adjustment under PDGM?

title: Remote Home Health Scribe – Clinical Documentation (Part-Time)
description:
About EZ Scribe LLC:

EZ Scribe LLC supports U.S. home health nurses with their clinical documentation. Nurses spend hours charting after every patient visit, and our scribes take that work off their plate so they can focus on patient care. Our mission is simple: reduce nurse burnout, improve accuracy, and give nurses their time back.



Position Overview:

This is a part-time, fully remote independent contractor role (about 20 hours per week), with the possibility of more hours after training. This is not a passive scribe position. You will turn nurse visit information into complete, accurate, and compliant documentation in the patient's electronic medical record (EMR), working inside EZ Scribe's secure systems.



What You Will Do:

- Review visit information submitted by home health nurses through EZ Scribe's secure systems

- Check it for completeness, accuracy, and clinical clarity, and ask for clarification when something is missing or doesn't add up

- Enter clean, organized, compliant documentation into the agency's EMR

- Learn and apply OASIS documentation standards (training provided)

- Review wound photos as part of documentation (you must be comfortable seeing wounds of varying severity)

- Communicate with your Team Lead and the nurses to resolve documentation issues

- Stay productive without constant supervision: when work slows down, check for pending items and follow up on incomplete documentation



Schedule:

- About 20 hours per week, scheduled between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM U.S. Pacific time (1:00 AM to 9:00 AM Philippine time). Hours are flexible.

- Time is tracked with our time-tracking phone app



Pay:

- $4.00 to $6.00 per hour based on experience, paid every two weeks

- This is an independent contractor role



HIPAA and Data Security (required):

You will handle protected health information (PHI) for U.S. patients. Protecting it is a non-negotiable part of this job.

- All work is done only inside the secure EZ Scribe Cloud PC we provide. No patient information is ever saved, copied, printed, photographed, or sent outside our systems.

- You must pass HIPAA training and a cyber security training before you receive access to any systems. Training is provided if you are not already certified.

- You will sign a confidentiality agreement and our contractor agreements before starting.

- You must provide an NBI clearance issued within the last 6 months.

- You must work in a private, quiet space where no one else can see your screen.



Requirements:

- Strong written English and reading comprehension

- Exceptional attention to detail: you catch what is missing, inconsistent, or doesn't add up

- Critical thinking: you can tell when something doesn't look right clinically and ask about it

- Ability to learn new EMR and charting systems quickly and work independently

- Typing speed of at least 45 words per minute with high accuracy

- Your own reliable computer, a smartphone, and high-speed internet

- A backup internet connection and backup power for outages

- Comfort working with clinical language and wound photos



Preferred Qualifications:

- U.S. home health experience, especially familiarity with OASIS (strongly preferred)

- A background in nursing, healthcare, or allied health

- Experience with electronic medical record systems (training on our systems is provided)

- Experience in medical scribing, medical transcription, or healthcare documentation



What We Offer:

- A fully remote position

- Structured training and onboarding, including OASIS and HIPAA

- Team Lead support and ongoing guidance

- Room to grow with EZ Scribe LLC

- Purpose-driven work that makes a real difference for home health nurses and their patients



How to Apply:

1. Write EZ CHART as the first line of your application. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

2. Attach your resume.

3. In a short introduction, tell us about any home health, OASIS, medical scribing, or other healthcare documentation experience and why you're a strong fit for detail-driven documentation work.

4. Include your typing speed (words per minute) and your internet speed.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short skills test using a practice nurse note. The practice note contains no real patient information.



Important Note:

We are looking for professionals who take initiative, think critically, and value accuracy. This is a performance-driven role where your attention to detail directly affects patient care.

title: Sports Card Research, Video Review & Data Entry Assistant

title: AI Automation Engineer – Hermes Agent Setup & AI Token Optimization
description:
AI AUTOMATION ENGINEER – HERMES AGENT SETUP & TOKEN OPTIMIZATION

Full-time | Remote | Long-term



ABOUT US

Brands Capital Group is a group of around 15 companies in e-commerce, third-party logistics (fulfillment warehouse in China) and online entrepreneur training. We work with clients across Europe. Our team already runs on Slack, ClickUp, Google Workspace, WhatsApp and many automations.

We now want a team of AI agents working alongside our staff in every business and at group level. We need the person who will build and run them.



THE ROLE

You will design, deploy and maintain AI agents built on Hermes Agent (the open-source agent framework by Nous Research). These agents will connect to our tools and do real daily work.

You will also keep AI costs under control. Each agent must use the right model for the job and spend no more tokens than it needs.



YOUR FIRST PROJECT: 6 AGENTS FOR OUR LOGISTICS COMPANY

• Finance & Metrics: monthly and on-demand reports (client debts, profitability overall and per sourcer, leads, new clients, affiliate sign-ups)

• Customer Issues: reads client Slack channels and the founder's DMs every day and flags anything unresolved

• Follow-up: asks for deadlines, sends reminders, receives alerts from all the other agents

• Competitor Watch: reads competitors' X and Instagram pages and lists their content ideas in a Google Sheet

• Photos & Videos: produces photos and videos from scripts, applies feedback, manages recurring AI avatars

• Sourcing & Quotations: finds similar products, posts links in Slack for our China team, lists factory contacts to negotiate better prices, looks for cheaper options every week

After this, you will roll the same approach out to our other businesses and to the group level.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Install, configure and host Hermes Agent securely and reliably

• Connect agents to Slack, WhatsApp, Google Sheets/Drive, ClickUp and other tools (APIs, MCP servers, webhooks)

• Write and maintain agent skills, prompts, memory and scheduled tasks (cron)

• Set up hand-offs between agents (for example, every agent reports to the Follow-up agent)

• Choose the right model for each task (premium vs. cheap/open-source models via OpenRouter or similar providers)

• Cut token usage: prompt caching, context trimming, summarization, batching, routing simple tasks to cheaper models

• Monitor cost per agent and per task, and send a short monthly cost report

• Test, debug and improve agents based on feedback from the team

• Document every agent clearly (what it does, how to fix it, how much it costs)



REQUIREMENTS

• 2+ years of hands-on automation work (n8n, Make, Zapier, Python scripts, APIs, webhooks)

• Proven experience building LLM agents or AI workflows that run in production, not just demos

• Experience with Hermes Agent, or a similar framework (OpenClaw, LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Code / Agent SDK…) and the ability to get up to speed on Hermes quickly

• Strong understanding of LLM pricing and token optimization

• Comfortable with Linux, Docker, Git and basic server security (API keys, secrets, access rights)

• Good written English

• Reliable, autonomous, able to explain technical choices simply



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol)

• Slack and WhatsApp bot experience (WhatsApp Business API, 
)

• Python or TypeScript

• E-commerce, Shopify or logistics background

• AI image/video tools (for the Photos & Videos agent)



WHAT WE OFFER

• Long-term, full-time position

• A real, ambitious AI project across about 15 companies

• Fast decisions and direct work with the founder



SCHEDULE

40 hours/week with at least 2 hours of daily overlap with Paris time (CET).



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be read.

1. Start your message with the subject: "AGENT BUILDER – [Your Name]"

2. Send your resume and links to your work (GitHub, portfolio, Loom demos)

3. Answer these 3 questions in a few lines each:

   a) Describe an AI agent or automation you built that is running in production today. What does it do, and which tools/models does it use?

   b) Give 3 concrete techniques you have used to reduce AI token costs, with the savings you got.

   c) Have you used Hermes Agent? If not, which agent framework do you know best?

**About the Opportunity**



We're a US-based software company building a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform that connects accounting, customer relationships, operations, workflows, and other essential business functions into one integrated system. After 18 months of development, we're looking for our first external software engineer to help complete our MVP, improve existing functionality, and prepare the product for launch. • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on Python/Django expertise.

• Strong knowledge of Django architecture, PostgreSQL, relational database design, and query optimization.

• Comfortable building interactive interfaces using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.

• Experience designing scalable, dynamic, and maintainable systems with reusable components and configurable business logic.

**Why Join Us**

title: Family Producer (Customer Care & Storytelling) – US Startup
description:
Please watch my Loom about Dearly and this role:



If the link doesn't appear, type: loom dot com / share / 590cced8bd4b4a4ea3f4eab5c
Dearly, a small startup based in San Francisco, is hiring a full-time producer: the person who takes care of our families and produces their Life Portraits. This is a remote role for someone who loves looking after people.



ABOUT DEARLY

Dearly makes Life Portraits: a film and an illustrated story of someone's whole life, made from what their family and friends share.

• A family starts for free and shares one private link. Everyone who loves the person adds photos, videos, voice messages and written memories from wherever they are.

• Our studio turns it all into one film and an illustrated story, kept together at one link. The family also receives an engraved wooden keepsake.

• Our software and AI handle much of the organizing and first drafts. People check and finish every Life Portrait, and every family talks with a real person: their producer.

Check it out! dearly.co



WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll be each family's one person at Dearly, from their first message to the check-ins after delivery. About 70% of the work is caring for families, and about 30% is producing their Life Portraits.

• Talk with families by chat, voice message and

• Help everyone add their memories, especially people who find technology hard, including seniors

• Review what people share, and polish each film and illustrated story before it's delivered

• Add thoughtful touches, like handwritten cards and gifts chosen for each family

• Help our founder, Jack, with occasional executive-assistant tasks

Many families come to us after a loss, or near the end of a loved one's life. This is a care role, not a sales role.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Someone kind, patient and reliable, who loves taking care of people.

• A natural host who notices the small things

• Calm and gentle with people who are grieving

• A clear, neutral American English accent. Families hear you in voice messages and calls, so this matters a lot to us.

• Excellent written English

• Patient helping people with technology

• Quick to learn new tools. We use our own Studio software, Slack, Notion, Linear, Google Workspace, Stripe and AI tools. You don't need to know them yet.

• Set up to work from home: a computer, a smartphone, a quiet space for calls, and reliable internet with a backup

• Nice to have: experience in hospitality, healthcare, caregiving, customer success or video editing



SCHEDULE

Our families are in the U.S., so this role follows U.S. hours.

• Families can reach you from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Pacific time, roughly midnight to noon in Manila.

• During those hours, you'd reply to families within about an hour. Messages come to your phone, so you don't need to sit at a computer the whole time.

• Until we add a second producer, which we hope will be around March, you'd be available seven days a week. Jack covers whenever you're sick or need time off.

• Expect about 10 hours of work a week in December, growing to about 30 to 50 hours a week in January and February.

• We launch on December 1, and we'd like our producer to start in December. If you're working another job, you can start part-time while you transition. If you'd like full-time hours sooner, tell us.



PAY

Pay has three parts, paid twice a month by Wise.

• Base pay: $500 in December, then $1,000 a month

• Seven-day availability: $250 a month, until a second producer joins

• Life Portrait bonus: $50 for each Life Portrait you complete

For example, a month with 5 completed Life Portraits while you're covering seven days comes to $1,500. At 25 a month after a second producer joins, it's $2,250.

This is an independent contractor role with a monthly salary. We don't track hours or record your screen.



TRAINING AND GROWTH

You'll learn the work side by side with Jack.

• In your first weeks, you'd talk with Jack for about an hour every other day, and d
 replies to families together until you're confident.

• You'd read Unreasonable Hospitality by Will Guidara and help set Dearly's standards for how we care for families.

• As we add producers, this role can grow into leading hospitality across Dearly.



OUR HIRING PROCESS

The process takes about 2-4 weeks.

1. Send a short video about yourself (see How to apply below).

2. Take our custom test: a personality and working-style questionnaire, plus a practice conversation where an AI plays a customer who needs your help. You won't need to know how Dearly works behind the scenes; you can improvise or use what's on our website.

3. Have a one-on-one video interview with Jack.

We'll reply to everyone who applies.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Reply to this post with the subject line: Family Producer – [Your Full Name]

2. In your reply, include a link to a video of yourself, 1 to 10 minutes long. Loom, Google Drive or a similar link is fine.

3. In the video, tell us about yourself, and what interests you about Dearly or how you see yourself fitting in here. Please don't use a script. We want to meet you as you are.

Applications without a video won't be reviewed. Please don't send a resume.



If you love taking care of people, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Financial Paraplanner
description:
About Ensign Partners



Ensign Partners brings simplicity to complexity by integrating legal, financial, tax, insurance, and advisory expertise under one roof. Our clients receive one coordinated plan, one trusted team, and a clear path forward.



We are a values-driven firm built on professionalism, trust, and long-term relationships. Every role at Ensign matters. We believe exceptional client experiences are created through consistency, accuracy, and people who take pride in doing things the right way.



Position Overview



Ensign Partners is seeking an experienced, highly organized, detail-oriented Senior Financial Paraplanner to support our growing financial planning practice.



This role is primarily responsible for building, analyzing, updating, and maintaining comprehensive financial plans using eMoney. You will work closely with our U.S.-based financial advisors and planning team to turn complex client financial information into accurate, actionable financial plans.



You will be responsible for gathering and organizing financial data, identifying missing information, developing planning scenarios, preparing reports, and ensuring financial plans are accurate and ready for advisor review.



While this is primarily a behind-the-scenes planning role, you may communicate directly with clients to gather missing information, clarify financial details, and ensure planning information is complete.



This position is ideal for someone with strong technical financial planning knowledge, advanced eMoney experience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage complex financial planning assignments.



Key Responsibilities



Build, update, analyze, and maintain comprehensive financial plans using eMoney.



Gather, organize, and evaluate client financial information, identifying missing data, inconsistencies, and planning opportunities.



Develop and model financial planning scenarios involving:



Retirement Planning and Retirement Income



Cash Flow and Budgeting



Investment and Portfolio Planning



Tax Planning Considerations



Life Insurance and Risk Management



Estate Planning Considerations



Business Ownership and Succession Planning



Education Funding



Wealth Accumulation and Distribution Strategies



Evaluate alternative financial planning strategies and clearly summarize assumptions, findings, and potential trade-offs for advisor review.



Prepare accurate financial planning reports, presentations, and supporting materials for client meetings.



Coordinate with financial advisors to incorporate recommendations, updated financial information, and changes in client circumstances into financial plans.



Communicate with clients as needed to obtain missing documents and clarify information required to complete their financial plans.



Review financial plans for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and potential issues requiring advisor attention.



Maintain clear documentation of planning assumptions, outstanding questions, recommendations, and updates.



Track outstanding tasks and ensure financial planning assignments continue moving efficiently through established workflows.



Maintain organized electronic client files and financial planning documentation.



Follow established systems, templates, checklists, and workflows consistently.



Manage multiple financial planning assignments while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high standard of accuracy.



Maintain the highest level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.



Support additional financial planning and administrative projects as assigned.



Required Qualifications:



Five or more years of professional financial planning experience, including experience with complex client financial situations.



Strong proficiency in eMoney, with the ability to independently build, analyze, and maintain detailed financial plans.



Comprehensive understanding of financial planning principles, including retirement, investments, insurance, taxes, estate planning, and cash flow management.



Experience developing and comparing financial planning scenarios and evaluating alternative strategies.



Ability to identify potential planning issues, question assumptions, and recognize matters requiring advisor or specialist review.



Exceptional attention to detail, analytical skills, and organization.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to interpret complex financial information and clearly communicate findings to financial advisors.



Ability to manage multiple planning assignments simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.



Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a financial planning team.



Professional demeanor with a strong commitment to quality, confidentiality, and client service.



Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.



Preferred Qualifications



CFP® certification or equivalent professional financial planning credentials — a significant advantage.



Advanced experience using eMoney for complex financial planning and scenario modeling.



Prior experience working with U.S.-based financial advisors, financial planning firms, or wealth management organizations.



Experience preparing comprehensive financial plans for high-net-worth individuals, families, and business owners.



Experience with advanced retirement income planning, tax-efficient strategies, and estate planning considerations.



Experience analyzing business ownership interests, succession planning, and business-related financial planning scenarios.



Familiarity with U.S. financial planning concepts, retirement accounts, investment structures, insurance products, and tax considerations.



Experience with financial planning CRM systems and client document management platforms.



Strong ability to identify inconsistencies, missing information, and opportunities for additional planning analysis.



Ability to take initiative, solve problems, and improve financial planning workflows.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means our financial advisors can confidently rely on accurate, current, and comprehensive financial plans that are ready when needed.



You proactively identify missing information, follow up on outstanding items, and ensure financial plans continue progressing without unnecessary delays.



Planning scenarios are thoughtfully developed, assumptions are clearly documented, and findings are organized in a way that allows advisors to easily review, understand, and communicate recommendations to clients.



You take ownership of your work, consistently deliver high-quality financial plans, and become a trusted member of our financial planning team.



Why Join Ensign Partners?



Ensign Partners is intentional about building a workplace where people are trusted, supported, and held to high standards. This role is an important part of helping individuals, families, and business owners make confident financial decisions.



Joining Ensign means:



Being part of a mission-driven, people-first firm.



Working in a professional, organized, and collaborative environment.



Having clear expectations and the opportunity to take ownership of your work.



Working alongside experienced U.S. financial advisors and professionals.



Gaining exposure to comprehensive financial planning involving investments, taxes, insurance, estate planning, and business ownership.



Contributing meaningfully to a growing and respected organization.



Building a long-term career with opportunities for professional growth.



If you have strong financial planning experience, advanced eMoney skills, and are committed to producing exceptional financial plans with accuracy and professionalism, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Ensign Partners team.

You should have already owned client relationships inside an established lead-generation, appointment-setting or outsourced-sales agency. We want someone who can explain what worked at a larger agency, what they personally improved, and how they would adapt it here.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

COMPENSATION

title: Content Strategist/Social Media Manager
description:
We are hiring a Content Strategist / Social Media Manager to plan, produce, and execute content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok for an established personal brand in the video marketing and monetization space.



This is a hybrid role. You will own the content planning process — building monthly plans, writing hooks, scripting videos, and tracking trends — AND you will execute that plan day to day: scheduling, publishing, managing the content calendar, and monitoring performance.



Content direction and final approval come from Keenya, but you are the person who turns her vision into a running system that never misses a beat.



You will have room to bring your own instincts to formatting, execution, and idea generation.



But this is not a role where you are setting the brand's overall strategic direction from scratch.



The win here is doing excellent work inside a clear system: planning with precision, executing with speed, and speaking up when something is working or when it is not.



About the Brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income.



We are a systems-driven team that moves fast, especially during launch periods, and we need someone who can keep pace without needing constant hand-holding.



What This Role Actually Is



You are the engine that keeps content moving every day — from the planning stage all the way through to publishing. You will build the content plans, write the hooks and captions, track what is trending, and then bring all of that to life across platforms on schedule.



You bring enough of your own judgment to catch what is working, flag what is not, and suggest adjustments in real time.



We are not looking for someone who only follows instructions with no instincts of their own.



We want someone with a genuine feel for short vertical video who can plan strategically, execute at a high level, and speak up when something is not landing.



What We Are Looking For



1. You can plan content that actually drives results

You build monthly content plans that include filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations for TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn.



Every piece aligns with our content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals so each video moves people toward a clear next step.



2. You have a real feel for short vertical video

You understand pacing, hooks, text overlay timing, and what makes a piece of content stop the scroll.



You track current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turn them into content ideas that fit our brand — not just follow trends blindly.



3. You can execute at volume, reliably

You manage content calendars, schedule and publish across multiple platforms, and keep everything organized without things falling through the cracks — especially during launch periods when volume increases.



You keep a clean, organized tracker so the team always knows what is approved, filmed, and scheduled.



4. You write hooks that stop the scroll and captions that sound human

You write on-screen text hooks that make people stop scrolling. Your captions feel like a real conversation, not a sales pitch.



You have a natural sense of voice and can write in a style that sounds like the person posting — not like generic marketing copy.



5. You are proactive, not just responsive

You flag what is underperforming, suggest small tweaks, and bring ideas to the table — without needing to own the entire strategic direction.



You know the difference between "I have a suggestion" and "I am going to change the plan."



6. You are highly organized and communicative

You meet deadlines without being chased, you do not go quiet when things get busy, and you are comfortable working inside an established system with clear processes.



You submit plans on a set schedule and revise them quickly based on feedback.



7. You are comfortable working under direction from the brand owner

This role reports into content direction set by Keenya. You should want that structure, not resent it.



You take direction well and give thoughtful input without needing to own every decision.



What This Role Involves



Planning

Building monthly content plans with filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations

Tracking current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turning them into on-brand content ideas

Aligning every piece with content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals

Submitting plans on a set schedule and revising quickly based on feedback

Execution

Publishing and scheduling content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok

Managing and maintaining the content calendar

Executing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs as directed, with room for your own polish on formatting and delivery

Keeping content organized in our shared systems (Google Workspace, ManyChat, Metricool)

Performance and Communication

Monitoring performance day to day and flagging what is working or not

Adapting quickly and staying responsive during active launches, live challenges, webinars, and campaigns

Communicating proactively — daily check-ins during active periods



You Are the Right Fit If...



You have real experience both planning and executing content at volume across multiple platforms

You understand short vertical video and can write strong hooks, plan pacing, and direct text overlays

You have a track record of creating content that drives engagement and turns into sales

You are highly organized and reliable with deadlines

You communicate proactively and do not disappear when things get busy

You are comfortable executing someone else's strategic direction while still bringing your own instincts to the work

You have strong written communication and a natural sense of voice

You have experience with spreadsheets, project trackers, and content management tools

You have a warm, collaborative personality — you will be part of a small team that works hard and has fun doing it



This Is Not the Right Role If...



You want to set the overall brand strategy yourself

You need full creative ownership over every decision

You struggle with deadlines, communication, or structured systems

You are only comfortable posting content, without any instinct for what is actually working

You are only comfortable planning content, without the ability to manage day-to-day publishing



Nice to Have



Experience in creator education, coaching, or marketing for women entrepreneurs

Familiarity with
 funnels and launch sequences



How to Apply



Start your application message with the word TIKTOK to confirm you have read the full posting.



Then answer the screening questions below and attach your resume and two or three examples of content you have planned or created that performed well, with results if you have them.



Your application should also include:



A brief note on your experience executing content across TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn — what platforms, what volume, what tools you have used

One or two examples of accounts where you handled both planning and execution — what your role was specifically, and what the results looked like

Your availability for a full-time role



Applications that are vague or do not include specifics on your actual planning and execution experience will not be reviewed.



Screening Questions



Walk us through a piece of content you planned that turned into sales. What was the hook, the format, the CTA, and the result?

Which TikTok or Instagram trend are you watching right now? Explain why it is working and how you would adapt it for women business owners.

Write a sample on-screen text hook (one line) for a video about why women business owners should stop waiting to feel ready before they start filming. Then give a second hook that uses a contrarian angle.



Our plans are due on a set day each month. Describe a time you met a tight deadline while keeping quality high. How did you prioritize?

How do you keep a content calendar organized when you are managing many pieces at once? What tools or systems do you use?

How do you make sure captions sound like the person who is posting them and not like generic marketing copy?

Tell us about a time you received feedback that changed your approach. How did you respond?

What does a healthy working relationship with a content owner look like to you, and how do you handle it when your ideas are not chosen?

Our team is small and works closely together. What do you enjoy most about collaborating on a creative team?

What is your availability each week, and what time zone are you working in?

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer / Technical Lead – AI-First Software Development
description:
WE ARE HIRING: Senior Full-Stack Developer / Technical Lead – AI-First Software Development



Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Employment: Full-Time, Long-Term

Company: Solomon prijevoz d.o.o. – Croatia, European Union

Salary: PHP 150,000–200,000/month, negotiable for exceptional candidates



About the Position



We are a growing European company looking for a highly experienced, independent, and results-oriented Senior Full-Stack Developer / Technical Lead with advanced AI-assisted development skills.



Our goal is to build high-quality web and mobile applications as efficiently and rapidly as possible by combining experienced software engineering with the most advanced AI development technologies available.



AI-powered development is a central part of this position, not an optional skill.



We are looking for someone who can independently build complete applications or lead a development team while maintaining full responsibility for the final product.



1. AI-First Development – A Core Requirement



We strongly believe that modern AI tools can significantly accelerate software development when used correctly by experienced professionals.



We expect our developer to actively use advanced AI technologies throughout the development process, including:



AI-assisted coding and software architecture

AI-powered debugging and code optimization

Automated test generation and quality assurance

AI-assisted frontend and backend development

Database design and API integration

Documentation and development workflow automation

AI-powered code analysis and security reviews



We are prepared to provide paid access to leading AI development tools, including Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI tools, and other professional AI solutions.



There is no fixed budget limitation on AI tools that can demonstrate meaningful improvements in development speed, productivity, and quality, subject to company approval.



We expect candidates to understand how to combine multiple AI tools effectively to maximize development efficiency.



2. Development Speed and Delivery Expectations



Development speed is one of our highest priorities.



We expect candidates to be capable of estimating realistic development timelines and using AI-assisted workflows to significantly reduce unnecessary manual work.



Candidates should be prepared to answer:



How quickly can you independently develop a basic but fully functional web application?

How long would you estimate for a medium-complexity business management application?

How much development time can you realistically save using AI-assisted programming?

What is your approach to delivering an MVP as quickly as possible?

How would your development speed improve with one or two additional developers?

Which AI tools would you use to achieve the fastest reliable development process?



We expect clear project milestones, weekly progress demonstrations, and realistic delivery commitments.



Our objective is to deliver production-ready applications in the shortest responsible timeframe, without compromising security, reliability, or code quality.



3. Human Code Review and Technical Accountability



AI-generated code must never be trusted or deployed without proper professional review.



This requirement is extremely important to our company.



Although we encourage extensive use of AI-generated code, the developer or Technical Lead must personally take responsibility for understanding, reviewing, validating, and testing the software.



Responsibilities include:



Reviewing AI-generated code before integration.

Ensuring the code follows professional software engineering standards.

Identifying security vulnerabilities, incorrect logic, and hidden errors.

Validating database operations, authentication, and API integrations.

Maintaining readable, scalable, and maintainable code.

Implementing automated and manual testing.

Performing regression testing before deployment.

Reviewing critical workflows and ensuring they function correctly.

Preventing AI-generated code from introducing unnecessary dependencies or security risks.

Ensuring confidential company and customer data is handled securely when using external AI tools.



AI is a development accelerator, not a replacement for professional engineering judgment.



The Technical Lead remains accountable for the quality and technical correctness of the delivered application.



4. Legal Compliance and Pre-Launch Verification



Before any application is released to the public, we require a comprehensive technical, operational, and legal compliance review.



The developer must ensure that all necessary legal and compliance requirements have been identified, implemented, and submitted for appropriate professional review.



This includes, where applicable:



Terms and Conditions / Terms of Service

Privacy Policy

Cookie Policy and consent management

GDPR and applicable EU data protection requirements

User consent and personal data processing

User registration, account management, and deletion procedures

Data retention and deletion policies

Payment processing, refunds, and cancellation procedures

Consumer protection requirements

Third-party API terms and licensing requirements

Intellectual property and software licensing

Security measures for user and business data

Applicable legal notices and mandatory disclosures



The developer is responsible for the correct technical implementation of approved legal requirements, coordinating necessary documentation, and identifying potential compliance gaps.



Final legal documents and regulatory interpretations must be reviewed and approved by qualified legal professionals before public launch.



No application may be released without completing the required testing, security checks, compliance review, and management approval.



5. Key Responsibilities



Take complete ownership of software development projects.

Convert detailed written specifications into functional applications.

Independently develop frontend, backend, databases, and integrations.

Design scalable and secure software architecture.

Use advanced AI development tools to accelerate delivery.

Provide accurate development estimates and project milestones.

Deliver functional MVPs rapidly.

Personally review and validate AI-generated code.

Lead, recruit, and coordinate additional developers when required.

Conduct testing, debugging, security reviews, and deployment.

Coordinate legal and compliance readiness before launch.

Maintain technical documentation and source code.

Provide transparent weekly progress reports.

Deliver applications within agreed project timelines.



6. Required Qualifications



Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience.

Preferably 7–10+ years of experience.

Strong full-stack development capabilities.

Proven experience delivering complete production applications.

Advanced practical experience with AI-assisted development tools.

Strong knowledge of React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, or equivalent technologies.

Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases and API integrations.

Experience with cloud deployment, CI/CD, and application security.

Strong understanding of code review, testing, and debugging.

Ability to independently plan and execute complex projects.

Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

Experience leading developers is highly preferred.



7. What We Offer



Competitive monthly salary of PHP 150,000–200,000.

Higher compensation negotiable for exceptional candidates.

Full-time remote employment opportunity.

Long-term collaboration with a European company.

Company-funded premium AI development tools.

Access to modern software development infrastructure.

High level of independence and technical responsibility.

Opportunity to recruit and manage a development team.

Direct communication with company ownership.

Multiple long-term software projects.

Performance-based compensation reviews and career growth opportunities.



8. Application Requirements



Please submit:



Updated CV and years of professional experience.

GitHub profile or portfolio of completed applications.

Two or more applications you personally built or technically led.

Your experience with AI coding tools and AI-assisted development.

Which paid AI tools you would recommend for maximum development productivity.

Estimated development time for a basic application and a medium-complexity business application, including your assumptions.

Your approach to reviewing and validating AI-generated code.

Your experience with GDPR, security, and production release processes.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Your earliest available starting date.



Shortlisted candidates will participate in a technical interview and may be invited to complete a paid practical assessment.



Our Expectations



We are not looking for someone who simply writes code or copies AI-generated solutions.



We are looking for an experienced software engineer who knows how to use AI to develop applications exceptionally efficiently while maintaining complete professional control over the final product.



Speed matters. Quality matters. Security matters. Accountability matters.



If you can independently turn detailed business requirements into reliable, production-ready software using modern AI-powered development workflows, we would like to hear from you.

description:
Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance incentives + sales bonuses, with high performers able to earn up to PHP 100,000 per month through bonus opportunities.

Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.

Leave: One week paid leave per year



About the Client



Our client is Australia’s leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating strong long-term career opportunities for high-performing individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, sales-driven role focused on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires strong multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence managing time-sensitive situations.



High-performing team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have the opportunity to progress into leadership roles and eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations



Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-moving dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We’re Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience working with Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What’s in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives

- Clear progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work culture

- Long-term career growth opportunities for high performers

title: Marketing Manager - Design, Reels & Copy (Australian Electrical & Solar)
description:
Love turning raw site photos and video clips into scroll-stopping Reels, carousels and ads? Want a long-term, full-time, work-from-home role on a day shift, finishing by 4:00 pm Philippine time, with an Australian company that pays above typical market rates? Read on.



ABOUT US

Audem Electrical and Audem Solar are electrical and solar businesses based in Queensland, Australia. We're building a brand people trust across social media, our websites, print and paid ads. We have real jobs, real customers and plenty of photos and footage. We need a creative, organised person to turn it into great content.



THE ROLE

As our Marketing Manager, you'll own content production for both brands. You'll work side by side with our Australian marketing lead, who sets the plan and the briefs and collaborates with you on designs. You'll turn those briefs into finished, on-brand work across every channel, and keep the whole content pipeline organised.



We want an independent, creative self-starter. You'll bring your own ideas, spot what's working and what isn't, and take a piece from blank page to finished work without needing your hand held. AI tools are welcome as helpers, but you're expected to not just use AI, but to actually think and create awesome work. We hire for original ideas, good taste and craft.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design Instagram posts, carousels and Stories, and edit Reels using our photos, video clips and your own original graphics.

- Write captions and schedule content in our monthly social media planner.

- Write blog posts for our websites.

- Design printed letters, flyers and magnets.

- Create graphics and copy for Meta 
 and Instagram) ads.

- Write video scripts, photo briefs and shot lists for our photographers and videographers.

- Keep our look, tone and messaging consistent across social, web, print and ads.

- File editable designs, raw footage and final exports in the right folders, every time.

- Help with other marketing tasks as they come up.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A portfolio that shows graphic design for both digital and print, plus short-form video editing (Reels, TikTok or similar).

- Copywriting experience, and clear, natural Australian English (we say "colour", not "color").

- You work independently, bring your own ideas and follow through without being chased.

- Strong organisation and attention to detail.

- You manage deadlines and rounds of revisions well while working remotely.

- This is a fully remote, work-from-home role. You provide your own computer (able to handle design and video work), headphones, reliable internet, a backup for power and internet interruptions, and a quiet place to work.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Pay: ₱63,000 to ₱127,000 a month (AUD $1,500 to $3,000), paid in PHP via Wise, based on your skills, experience and portfolio.

- Signing bonus: AUD $300 (about ₱12,700) once you complete 6 months with us.

- A full-time, long-term role (independent contractor engagement), not a short project.

- Fully remote, work from home. You provide your own computer, headphones, reliable internet and a backup for power and internet interruptions.

- Adobe and Canva Pro provided by Audem.

- Day shift: 8 paid hours between 6:00 am and 4:00 pm Philippine time. No graveyard shift.

- Varied creative work across two brands, and the chance to grow with a growing Australian business.



HOURS

Full time, 8 paid hours a day, Monday to Friday, worked between 6:00 am and 4:00 pm Philippine time (8:00 am to 6:00 pm Brisbane time). Your lunch and breaks sit inside that window. Brisbane is 2 hours ahead of Manila all year round, so the schedule never shifts.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply using the OnlineJobs.ph Apply button. The first line of your message must be: SUNRISE - Your Name - Marketing Manager (applications without SUNRISE won't be reviewed).



Include:

1. Your portfolio link, showing design (digital and print) and short-form video. Tell us which parts you did yourself.

2. One video, 5 to 8 minutes (Loom, Google Drive or unlisted YouTube link). Both of the following must be in this same video, not as a separate file or
:

   - First, who you are, then walk us through one portfolio piece you're proud of, including your thinking, the drafts and what you changed along the way.

   - Then, the most important part: look at 
, 
 and our social pages, and tell us what you would change about the marketing of Audem Electrical and Audem Solar. You have full creative freedom. What would you do in the next 90 days, and what would you do with a budget of AUD $10,000 a month? It could be literally anything. If you have original content ideas, include them in this part of the video.

3. Short answers to these two questions (in your own words, please; we can tell):

   - Write a caption (under 60 words) for a Reel showing a new solar system on a family home in Brisbane.

   - How do you organise your files so anyone on the team can find the editable design, the raw footage and the final export?

4. Your expected monthly rate in PHP and your earliest start date.



Applicants who follow these instructions will be sent a short practical task using real Audem files, then invited to a video interview.



We read every application that follows these instructions, and we can't wait to see your work.

title: Sales Closer – Local Service Business Clients – $4-15/hr + Uncapped Commission (US Hours)
description:
We run The GRID — a done-for-you growth system for local service businesses in the US (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and similar trades). We're hiring one person to run our outbound sales process end to end: reach out to business owners, show them a real, specific problem with their online presence (their website, their Google listing, how they handle missed calls), and close them into a paid engagement.



This is not a script-reading, dial-and-transfer job. You'll need to actually understand what we do well enough to look at a business's website and Google listing and explain, in plain language, what's likely costing them money — then close the deal yourself, with no handoff. If your background is high-volume generic cold-calling or appointment-setting with no interest in understanding the product, please don't apply — you won't pass the first screen and it'll waste both our time.



What you'll do:



Call and
 US local service business owners, opening with a specific, real observation about their business — never a generic pitch. Review a prospect's website and Google Business Profile before or during the call to find real gaps (no online booking, thin reviews, outdated site, no after-hours coverage). Walk owners through our guarantee ($2,000 in real findings, in writing, or we pay them $1,000) as the core of the pitch. Close the deal yourself — there is no separate closer, you are the closer. Log every call and outcome accurately.



What you need:



Fluent, clear spoken English. You will be on live calls with US business owners. This is the single hard requirement — your application video is how we check it, not your resume. Real closing experience — not just appointment-setting or lead qualification. Comfortable learning enough about websites, Google Business Profiles, and basic CRM tools (we use GoHighLevel) to talk credibly about a business's gaps — you don't need to be technical. Able to work US business hours — state your actual overlap in hours in your application. A quiet space and reliable internet for calls; reliable and self-directed day to day.



Pay:



Open range: $6/hr up to a $15/hr cap, plus uncapped commission on every deal you close, from day one.



As a rough monthly reference at full-time hours (160 hrs/month), that's roughly $960–$2,400/month base, before any commission — commission is where real earning happens here, and there's no ceiling on it. Lower base + higher commission will out-earn higher base + lower commission for anyone actually closing deals. If you'd rather have more guaranteed income with a smaller cut per deal, that's available too, capped at $15/hr base.



Tell us in your application where on this $4-15/hr range you'd want to start, and why. There's no wrong answer — we want to see how you think about risk and reward before we ever get on a call.



Hours: 15-30+/week to start, scaling with output and results.



How to apply:



Start your application with the word PHOENIX — if it doesn't start with that word, we assume you didn't read the full post and we won't review it.

Send a 60-90 second voice or video recording telling us about your sales/closing experience and why you'd be good at this. Voice note is fine — we're listening for how you communicate, not production quality.

In writing, tell us: your available hours and overlap with US business hours (Eastern or Central time), and where on the $6-15/hr range you'd want to start and why.



Applications that skip the PHOENIX keyword or the voice/video clip will not be reviewed, regardless of resume.
